We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Tuesday, February 10, 2026 - 05:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers - 1 Steere Street, Bridgetown

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Ordinary Council Meeting 27 August 2025

Wednesday, August 27, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers - 1 Steere Street, Bridgetown

Agenda

OCM Agenda 27 August 2025 (181.11 MB)

Minutes

OCM Minutes 27 August 2025 (50.07 MB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Office Hours

Monday - Friday
9:00am - 4:30pm

Ordinary Council Meeting 6 February 2025

Thursday, February 6, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers - 1 Steere Street, Bridgetown

Agenda

Agenda Ordinary Council Meeting 6 February 2025 (17.30 MB)

Minutes

CONFIRMED Minutes 6 February 2025 Ordinary Council Meeting (18.52 MB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Monday - Friday
9:00am - 4:30pm

Special Council Meeting 4 December 2025

Thursday, December 4, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Town Hall, 1 Steere street Bridgetown

Agenda

SCM Agenda 4 December 2025 (735.04 KB)

Minutes

SCM Minutes 4 December 2025 - confirmed (971.86 KB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Wednesday, May 14, 2025 - 05:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers - 1 Steere Street, Bridgetown

Agenda

Agenda Special Council Meeting 14 May 2025 - Public COPY (431.12 KB)

Minutes

CONFIRMED Minutes Special Council Meeting 14 May 2025 - Public COPY (645.26 KB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. Ordinary Council Meeting - 25 January 2024

Thursday, January 25, 2024 - 05:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Agenda

Agenda - Ordinary Council Meeting January 2024 (8.21 MB)

Urgent Business - Late Item C22 0124 - Wandillup Fire Station - Reduction in setbacks - website (1.14 MB)

Minutes

CONFIRMED - Minutes-Ordinary-Council-Meeting-January-2024 (3.05 MB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Office Hours

Monday - Friday
9:00am - 4:30pm

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Special Council Meeting 8/2/2024

Thursday, February 8, 2024 - 05:30 PM

Location: Council Chambers

Agenda

Agenda - Special meeting - 8 February 2024 (304.01 KB)

Minutes

CONFIRMED Minutes - Special meeting - 8 February 2024. (849.70 KB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Location: Council Chambers

A Special Meeting of Council is to be held at 5.30pm, Monday 13 November 2023 in the Council Chambers for the purpose of:

  2. A confidential staffing matter

Members of the public are welcome to attend the meeting.  Note Public Question Time is restricted to questions on the business of the special meeting only.

Special Council Meeting - 24 October 2023

Tuesday, October 24, 2023 - 05:30 PM

A Special Meeting of Council is to be held at 5.30pm, Tuesday 24 October 2023 in the Council Chambers for the purpose of:

  1. swearing-in newly elected Councillors
  2. electing and swearing-in of Shire President
  3. electing and swearing-in of Deputy President
  4. allocation of seating arrangements for the 2023/25 term of office
  5. determining the suite of Advisory Committees and approving their Instruments of Appointment.

Members of the public are welcome to attend the meeting.  Note Public Question Time is restricted to questions on the business of the special meeting only.

The agenda for the meeting will be available for public viewing here or at the Bridgetown Library during operating hours, from Friday 20 October 2023.

An additional Special Meeting of Council is to be held on Tuesday 24 October 2023 in the Council Chambers for the purpose of:

  1. Granting CEO delegated authority to vary Restricted Burning Periods
  2. Additional and urgent specific gravel road works.

The meeting will commence directly after the conclusion of the previous special meeting.

Members of the public are welcome to attend the meeting.  Note Public Question Time is restricted to questions on the business of the special meeting only.

The agenda for the meeting can be viewed here or at the Bridgetown Library during operating hours, from Monday 23 October 2023.

Special Council Meeting - 9 February 2023

Thursday, February 9, 2023 - 05:30 PM

Agenda

Agenda - 9 February 2023 (5.33 MB)

Minutes

Minutes - 9 February 2023 (5.32 MB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Office Hours

Monday - Friday
9:00am - 4:30pm

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Special Council Meeting - 14 July 2022

Thursday, July 14, 2022 - 05:30 PM

Agenda

Agenda - 14 July 2022 (842.57 KB)

Minutes

Minutes - 14 July 2022 (824.78 KB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Updated information

Published on Tuesday, 12 April 2022 at 12:57pm

A Special Council has been called for tonight, Tuesday 12 April 2022. It will be held at the Bridgetown Leisure Centre (BLC) from 5:30pm. All electors, regardless of vaccination status, are welcome to attend the meeting providing that face masks are worn inside the BLC (unless a medical exemption can be provided on entry). Under the State Government mandate of one person per two square metres, only 360 people can be accommodated on the double court, separated seating will be available.
The livestream for tonight’s meeting is being run by Whiting Video. The livestream link has been updated, please share this information with those who are intending on watching the meeting. https://tinyurl.com/shirespecialmeeting
Further background and information on tonight’s meeting can be found here.

News: Special Council Meeting Details

Published on Monday, 11 April 2022 at 9:30:00 AM

A Special Council Meeting has been called for the purpose of considering the motions carried at the Special Meeting of Electors held on Monday 28 March 2022. The motions that were carried at the Electors meeting can be found by clicking here. It has been determined that the subject matter of the meeting is an interest in common to all electors and therefore no presentations or comments on the agenda will be permitted.

The Special Council Meeting is being held on Tuesday 12 April 2022 at The Bridgetown Leisure Centre from 5:30pm and is open to the public. As with the Special Meeting of Electors, this Meeting will be live streamed through the Shire’s Facebook Page. A livestream event has been created for easy access, please click here for the scheduled event. Please note that this livestream is publicly available and can be watched without the need for a Facebook account.

The meeting is being held at the Bridgetown Leisure Centre to allow for greater attendance that cannot be accommodated at the Council Chambers. Under the State Government’s COVID-19 mandate of one person per two square metres, only 360 people can be accommodated on the double court. This is the maximum attendance that can be allowed at the meeting. We estimated that 170 electors attended the March meeting.

With the potentially large number of attendees, there will be speakers set up for members of the public in attendance and microphones set up for our Councillors and members of the public wanting to ask question during Public Question Time.

Public Question Time is on the agenda for this meeting, those wanting to ask a question relevant to the subject matter must be present at the meeting. Questions received in advance from members of the public not intending to appear at the meeting will not be accepted. There will be no opportunities for deputation or presentations from members of the public.

For more information on the Special Council Meeting, the agenda of the meeting and minutes of the Special Meeting of Electors, please click here.

Notice of Special Council Meeting

A Special Meeting of Council is to be held at 5.30pm, Tuesday 12 April 2022 in the Bridgetown Leisure Centre for the purpose of considering the motions carried at the Special Meeting of Electors held on 28 March 2022.

The meeting is open to the public and will include public question time on the subject of the meeting.

Tim Clynch
Chief Executive Officer

Late Item - EHO Vehicle (172.60 KB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

August - Calling of Special Council Meeting by Shire President (130.13 KB)

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

We acknowledge the cultural custodians of the land, the Kaneang, Pibelmen and Wadandi people. We acknowledge and support their continuing connection to the land, waterways and community. We pay our respects to members of the Aboriginal communities and their culture; and to Elders past and present, their descendants still with us today, and those who will follow in their footsteps.

Council Meetings

Council Meetings are held on a Thursday, from February through to December. The December meeting date is determined each year and is dependent upon when Christmas falls. Meetings will take place in the Council Chambers commencing at 5.30pm, excepting the months of May and November, where the meetings are to be held at the Greenbushes Community Resource Centre. 

Meetings are open to the public, with those in attendance having the opportunity to address Council. Agendas will be available for inspection at the Bridgetown Library during operating hours or online using the links below, a minimum of three (3) days prior to an ordinary meeting.
